text: Evening, I'm a foster carer and I've had Jayden (11) with me for about 3 months. He came out in chickenpox yesterday, proper itchy spots all over his tummy and back and he keeps scratching them. Tonight his temprature was 38.7 so I gave him some calpol about an hour ago. Apart from the spots and the itching he's honestly fine in himself, he's eaten his tea and he's been on his game for most of the evening. Theres also a bit of a red rash round the spots, more blotchy, and I did the glass test like you're meant to and it does go pale when I press it, so I'm not too worried about that, I just wanted to mention it. His breathing is completly normal, no wheezing or anything, he's not struggling at all. One more thing, before anyone panics if he gets seen: he has purple marks all up his shins but that's felt tip. He was drawing 'tattoos' on himself with his little cousins earlier. I scrubbed one bit with a wet flannel and it came straight off so it's just pen, nothing to do with the rash. Mainly I wanted to check what I should be keeping an eye on overnight with the chickenpox and the temp, and whether there's anything I can use for the itch thats ok at his age. Thanks
